headline: Oura sues Ultrahuman again over its new Ring Pro smart ring
summary: Oura filed a new lawsuit, in Texas federal court, against Ultrahuman, alleging its new Ring Pro product infringes two of Oura's patents. The suit threatens to block Ultrahuman's planned return to the US smart ring market.

claims.statement: Oura sued Ultrahuman again, this time in Texas federal court, over Ultrahuman's new Ring Pro product.
